attributes.name: Druva - Backup Data Deletion Attempt
attributes.description: Detects attempts to delete protected backup data, snapshots, restore points, or other recovery assets.
author: Druva
false_positives: Approved expiration or cleanup of obsolete recovery assets.
Authorized deletion performed under documented retention or data-lifecycle procedures.
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and druva.event_type:"Backup Data Deletion Attempt"
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects an attempt to delete Druva backup data, snapshots, restore points, or related recovery assets. Such activity may directly reduce an organization's ability to recover from an incident.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the administrator, source IP, affected resource, and recovery asset.
- Determine whether the deletion succeeded or was prevented.
- Confirm whether the activity is covered by an approved retention, cleanup, or decommissioning process.
- Review other deletion attempts and protection changes by the same administrator.
- Search for UDA, ransomware, privilege, authentication, retention, or repository events around the same time.
- Determine whether sufficient independent recovery points remain.

#### Response

- Escalate unauthorized deletion attempts.
- Preserve remaining recovery assets.
- Investigate and restrict the responsible account when compromise is suspected.
